description: I lead the Bulgaria-based members of Proactive Analytics at Experian, delivering credit analytics and reporting for the U.S. market.
responsibilities: As sole developer, designed and built a self-service platform with five reporting workflows for presentations, spreadsheets and interactive dashboards. Development began during my Data Modeller role.
Reduced generation time for reports of 50 or more pages from one day to several minutes using LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Built text-to-SQL and conversational tools. Evaluator agents check financial figures against source calculations and flag unsupported interpretations.
Tested the platform and prepared it for deployment with parallel workers, input validation, role-based access and secure sharing.

description: In Proactive Analytics, I built reporting pipelines for U.S. credit-market and customer-borrowing analyses.
responsibilities: Replaced single-client notebooks with configurable pipelines that supported multiple clients per run. Report preparation fell from about one day to one hour per report.
Reduced Tableau dashboard deployment from several days to one day and optimised database schemas for credit analytics.
Analysed tens of millions of U.S. loans and delivered over 90 customer-borrowing presentations to more than 50 clients, alongside 39 credit-market reports.
Engineered features for credit-score prediction, income estimation and behavioural forecasting. Adjusted comparisons for late-reported loans and duplicate consumers.

description: Designed the architecture and database models for the AI Readiness Analysis platform and built its frontend and backend.
responsibilities: Built React and Next.js interfaces with server-side rendering, Node.js services and OAuth authentication.

description: Studied how the complexity of a handwritten mathematical expression could guide the choice of recognition model.
responsibilities: Trained a classifier to select CoMER or SAN using character count, ink density and ratio features.
Reached 65.21% expression recognition on CROHME 2019, compared with 64.39% for CoMER and 53.52% for SAN.
Added YOLO-based symbol detection and segmentation and implemented multi-GPU processing.
